[LGRA.9.6.3] **Spellings the compiler refuses in favour of a member, a
cast or an operator.** The compiler must refuse each spelling below with
`DS_VALIDATE_RETIRED_BUILTIN_SPELLING`, naming the spelling that replaces it,
rather than with an unknown-function or unknown-member error.

| Refused | Written as |
|---|---|
| `bit_count(x)` | `x.bit_count` ([LEXP.3.7.1]) |
| `bit_length(x)` | `x.bit_length` ([LEXP.3.7.1]) |
| `utc(t)` | `t.utc` ([LTIM.3.1.1]) |
| `local(t, tz)` | `t.local(tz)` ([LTIM.3.2.1]) |
| `math.floor(t, d)`, in either form of its import ([LIMP.3.3.4]), with a `Time` or `Date` first argument | `t.floor(d)` ([LTIM.7.1]) |
| `add_months(t, n)`, `add_years(t, n)` | `t.add_months(n)`, `t.add_years(n)` ([LTIM.4.3.1]) |
| `t.to_string()`, `d.to_string()` without a format | `t::String`, `d::String` ([LCST.4.5.9]) |
| `dur.to_string()` | `dur::String` ([LCST.4.5.9]) |
| `is_null(x)` | `x is null` ([LNUL.4.9]) |
